module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Sub-Account Account Frozen / Trading Disabled by Compliance
precondition: Sub-account #4 frozen due to expired KYC; Master submits order.
expected_result: Sub-account #4 skipped cleanly with 'Account Frozen'; remaining active accounts receive proportionally scaled orders.
actual_result: Frozen or compliance-flagged sub-accounts are skipped during fan-out while active accounts fill normally.
